inshell.title: Inshell
inshell.description: Inshell is an anonymous artist. The practice asks people to inspect the self beneath its shells.

agent-art.title: Agent Art
agent-art.description: Agent Art is art in which an Agent participates at the level of intention.

movements.title: Movements
movements.description: Inshell's movements follow an artistic path from an individual's thought, through a crowd's will, toward Inshell's core.

thought.title: THOUGHT
thought.description: THOUGHT is one bounded Agent Art practice: an exact human–Agent exchange becomes a globally unique work.

will.title: WILL
will.description: WILL is Inshell's crowd movement about delegated human will and Agent action.

awa.title: AWA
awa.description: AWA is Inshell's movement from the crowd toward its core.

path.title: $PATH
path.description: $PATH carries permission and progress across Inshell's movements.

pulse.title: Pulse
pulse.description: Pulse turns public timing into the issue price for each new $PATH.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.description: Contract responsibilities remain separate across auction, issuance, permission, and artwork minting.

artwork-metadata-chain.title: Artwork, Metadata, and Chain
artwork-metadata-chain.description: Artwork and metadata stay legible only when their chain and release context stay attached.

fully-onchain.title: Fully Onchain
fully-onchain.description: Inshell keeps a work's canonical image and metadata with its onchain record so the work does not depend on a website or media host.

mono-76.title: Mono 76
mono-76.description: Mono 76 is Inshell's sealed native-SVG type system for deterministic artwork text.

verification.title: Verification
verification.description: Verification separates records, releases, observations, and claims before drawing conclusions.

wallet-local-data.title: Wallet and Local Data
wallet-local-data.description: Wallet actions, browser storage, Agent runs, and chain records cross different trust boundaries.

source-release-boundaries.title: Source and Release Boundaries
source-release-boundaries.description: Source ownership, release artifacts, deployments, and publication are versioned independently.

lineage.title: Lineage
lineage.description: Separating the person who specifies a work from whatever carries it out is an old move in art; Agent Art inherits the question, not the authority.

generative-art.title: Generative Art
generative-art.description: Inshell's pivot from generative art toward Agent Art began when a fixed procedure no longer exhausted what a machine could contribute to a work.

agents-and-ai.title: Agents and AI
agents-and-ai.description: A program executes, a model samples, and an Agent can bring thinking power into a work; Agent Art turns on whether intent formed through that power participates.

svg.title: SVG
svg.description: SVG is a text document that describes shapes, which is why a person, a browser, a contract, and an Agent can all read the same artwork.

ethereum.title: Ethereum
ethereum.description: The chain is a deterministic public machine with a price on every byte, and that price is a formal constraint rather than an inconvenience.

tokens-and-nfts.title: Tokens and NFTs
tokens-and-nfts.description: A token is a record that names a work; most tokens only point at one, and pointers decay.

onchain-art.title: Onchain Art
onchain-art.description: Onchain is a spectrum, and the useful question is which part of a work the chain actually holds.

design-principles.title: Design Principles
design-principles.description: Inshell's design rules connect participation, visible form, and the limits of evidence.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.description: Working definitions of the terms these documents depend on, each pointing to the article that owns the full account.
